foodName: Grilled Salmon with Glaze and Grilled Vegetables
assumptions: I am assuming a standard serving size of salmon (4-6 oz) and typical amounts of vegetables. The glaze is assumed to be a honey-soy based glaze.

instructions.instruction: Prepare the glaze: In a small bowl, whisk together honey, soy sauce, minced garlic, ginger, and a pinch of red pepper flakes.
Marinate the salmon: Place the salmon fillet in a dish and pour the glaze over it. Let it marinate for at least 15 minutes.
Prepare the vegetables: Wash and chop the zucchini, yellow squash, and red onion into slices or wedges. Toss the vegetables with olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Preheat the grill: Preheat your grill to medium-high heat.
Grill the vegetables: Place the vegetables on the grill and cook for about 5-7 minutes, flipping occasionally, until they are tender and slightly charred.

Grill the salmon: Place the marinated salmon on the grill, skin-side down if it has skin. Cook for about 4-6 minutes per side, or until the salmon is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork. Baste with extra glaze during the last few minutes of grilling.
Serve: Serve the grilled salmon with the grilled vegetables. Garnish with fresh parsley, if desired.
